label: input p at original positions 4-6 in sequences starting with 0
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.003% of steps). Fires almost exclusively in the original phase when the input token is p (88% of mass) at positions 4-6, in sequences whose first token is the digit 0 (98% of mass). The conjunction captures ~85% of activation mass but only ~12% of such steps activate, so another factor gates it: activations are stronger/more likely when the preceding context contains 3, k, p or a (e.g. prev_tok 3 has 11x lift; adding seen([3,k,p,a]) raises precision to ~25% at 79% mass recall), and when the sequence has more digits. The top example (0 1 a k 3 p) is 2x the next. Small residual fires on non-p tokens right after a 3 in 0-initial sequences. Does not fire in the copy phase (even when p is fed back), at t<4, or in sequences not starting with 0.
